issues.where: the shallow foreground water and lake bed (also visible in set-A-06.png)
issues.what: the dense 3D submerged golden-amber algal filaments, submerged limestone rocks, and vertical streams of rising gas bubbles in -a are replaced by a flat, sparse, wispy procedural texture with no submerged rocks and no bubbles
issues.fix: build volumetric, intertwined filamentous algae over visible submerged limestone rocks and add rising streams of glistening gas bubbles through clear shallow water

issues.where: the foreground shoreline, bottom-left inlet, and boulders (also visible in set-A-02.png)
issues.what: the framing boulders, rushing whitewater stream on the bottom left, and sloping talus bank are replaced by a flat grey procedural gravel beach with scattered low-poly faceted rocks and an unnatural pale streak across the left gravel
issues.fix: restore the rocky foreground framing, the flowing whitewater inlet on the bottom left, and natural fractured angular scree and boulders instead of flat procedural gravel and uniform rocks

issues.where: the foreground shore and shallow water surface (also visible in set-A-04.png)
issues.what: the foreground ground shows a flat stretched texture with visible repeating mirrored tile seams, and the shallow water is a smooth murky mirror missing the crisp concentric drinking ripples, golden-brown algal tufts, and broken reflections, with blurry dark artifacts floating on the surface
issues.fix: replace the tiled foreground texture with natural out-of-focus cobbles, add textured golden-brown algae in the shallows, break up the mirror reflections with sharp concentric ripples around the legs and muzzles, and remove the floating surface artifacts

issues.where: the lake surface and orange-ochre mineral apron
issues.what: the textured mineral and algal flats with interspersed sky-reflecting pools and a crisp deep-blue circular center with concentric ripples are replaced by painted-looking swirling orange streaks on a glossy plane that push back the blue basin and lose the central ripples
issues.fix: separate the textured emergent mineral flats and shallow reflective water pools from a clear, deep-blue circular center with subtle concentric ripples

issues.where: the herd along the foreground shoreline (also visible in set-A-02.png)
issues.what: the animals are brightly lit with warm direct golden light while standing on a cool shaded beach, whereas in -a they sit naturally inside the cool ambient shadow of the crater rim
issues.fix: place the foreground animals in cool ambient shadow matching the shaded shoreline and soften their harsh ground contact shadows

issues.where: the far shoreline mist and distant crater cliffs
issues.what: the thick luminous band of low mist along the far shore is nearly gone and the distant cliffs are razor-sharp and high-contrast instead of softly out of focus
issues.fix: restore the dense low mist hovering over the far water edge and add shallow depth-of-field blur and atmospheric haze to the distant cliffs

issues.where: the distant crater cliffs and far water edge
issues.what: the background cliffs are rendered in sharp, high-contrast focus with minimal shoreline mist, losing the telephoto lens separation and misty depth of -a
issues.fix: soften the background cliffs with shallow depth of field and increase atmospheric haze and low mist along the base of the far rim

issues.where: the drinking animal and midground water reflection
issues.what: the animal has chalky, rough bumpy surface shading without cool shadow modeling or dripping water droplets, the reflection in the water is too glassy and unbroken, and a sharp high-contrast cliff reflection cuts across the midground while the right-side concentric ripples are missing
issues.fix: smooth the animal's skin shading with warm rim light, cool shadow tones, wet lower legs, and dripping belly droplets, soften the midground cliff reflection, and add concentric ripples across the water

issues.where: the lighting and surface finish on the animals
issues.what: the animals appear chalky and flatly lit with harsh bumpy displacement and dry-looking legs instead of soft warm rim lighting, cool shadow bounce, and wet darkened lower legs
issues.fix: match the directional warm rim light and cool shadow fill of -a, refine the skin micro-detail, and darken the wet lower legs where they enter the water
